fields.description: Ellison sits at the entrance to Town Square’s main park. NSHAMA advertises one- to three-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom duplexes, with boulevard views. Its official page marks construction underway and carries a September 2026 update.
amenities: Indoor and outdoor children’s play areas

sources.label: NSHAMA Ellison project and construction update

reviewCoverage.identity: Own project and named Ellison documents verified; portal Ellison at Town Square is same identified project.
reviewCoverage.location: Own introduction places homes at main park entrance in Town Square, Dubai; exact existing registry used, no generic journey times.
reviewCoverage.residences: Own 1–3BR and 3BR duplex mix retained. Ten retrieved numerical plan families are single-level apartments; no duplex size invented.
reviewCoverage.areas: All ten full numerical drawings individually viewed. Printed built-up totals used, inclusive of balconies; suite-only figures not substituted.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own brochure page 19 visually read; six named features adopted, generic community lists excluded.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Bayut AED 960,000 launch reference retained as historical, not current availability. PF selected-listing headline AED 1.1m is a different price basis; primary list missing.
reviewCoverage.payment: Official image sheet visually read: 10/10/5/10/10/55 on original February 2025–November 2027 calendar; no inferred date rollover.
reviewCoverage.handover: Own sheet November 2027 matches PF. Primary current construction update September 2026 is not a measured completion percentage; portal progress figures differ and are not adopted.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official 32-page brochure, ten-page plans and one-page payment retrieved. Duplicated plans pooled, combined PDF allocation 200; generic community derivation zero.

overview: Five one-bedroom drawings provide different balcony and living-room arrangements. The published three-bedroom Type A also shows a maid’s room.
An advertisement for a duplex does not substitute for its actual two-level drawing. That family remains a document gap here.
research.locationNote: NSHAMA describes Ellison at the entrance to Town Square’s main park, with boulevard views. Confirm the outlook of the particular apartment.
research.priceNote: Bayut publishes AED 960,000 as launch price. Property Finder’s selected-listing headline is AED 1.1m with a sold-out label. Neither is an official current stock quotation.
research.paymentNote: Original February 2025–November 2027 calendar; confirm fresh contractual payment dates.
research.handoverNote: November 2027 is indicative in the developer sheet. Own construction update September 2026 gives no certified percentage.
